description: Mono-in, stereo-out reverb of a large room, built on Gverb

params.text: Sets the size of the room in metres, up to 300, which sets how long the tail can be
Sets how long the tail takes to die away, up to 50 seconds
Damps the high frequencies in the tail, none at one end and 0.9 at the other
Filters the signal going into the reverb, dull at one end and open at the other
Sets the level of the early reflections in the output
Sets the level of the late tail in the output

inputs.text: The signal going into the reverb
0V to 10V adds up to 300 metres to the room size
0V to 10V adds up to 50 seconds to the reverb time
Volts here are added to the damping, a volt being the whole range
Volts here are added to the input bandwidth, a volt being the whole range
Volts here are added to the early reflection level, 10V being the whole range
Volts here are added to the tail level, 10V being the whole range

outputs.text: The left channel of the reverb
The right channel of the reverb

inputs.3:
continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 0.9V.
inputs.5:
continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
